description: This file defines a React hook and associated utility for performing progressive batch processing (e.g., expanding tree nodes) in a React application. It includes a non-React utility to process items in batches using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, along with a hook to integrate this functionality with React component state.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object for progressively processing items in batches, with start and cancel methods, progress callbacks, and adaptive batching based on total items.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the utility controller, managing UI state such as running status and progress, and provides methods to start processing items in batches and cancel ongoing processing.

ctags.signature: ({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
